item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President immediately extends the legal validity of qualifying import licenses until a specified date, directly affecting import authorization without requiring a later agency decision.","evidence":"Any license for the importation of crude oil or gasoline as defined in Proclamation 4744 and issued thereunder shall remain valid, for purposes of Proclamation 3279, as amended, until 12:01 a.m. September 1, 1980"}]}
